_comment: Integrity-layer paths for your PRIVATE data repo. Installed as .integrity-paths.json at its root by scripts/setup-private-repo.sh. Read by the local git hooks and by auto-merge.yml.
_l1_note: L1 = strictly append-only: lines may be added, never changed or removed.
_l2_note: L2 = edits allowed, but bulk deletion, dropped sections and file deletion are blocked.
_authors_note: Approved commit authors. The setup script fills in your GitHub no-reply address. github-actions[bot] authors the merge commits.
